messages:
maria.docs: Heads-up: found a couple issues in the welcome quickstart (hello-lite) that block first deploy for new users — env var name mismatch and the JS snippet uses an old SDK import. Can someone pair on a tiny fix?

sam.devex: :eyes: which file/line? I can patch the snippet and run the smoke tests.

maria.docs: In https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/blob/main/quickstart/hello-lite.md around the setup section: steps tell users to set REDWOOD_TOKEN but our SDK expects REDWOOD_API_KEY. Also the JS snippet uses `import { Redwood } from '@redwood/sdk'` (v5 style).

alex-sdk: Yep, v6 changed the default. It should be: 
```js
import Redwood from '@redwood/sdk'
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY })
const resp = await client.text.generate({ model: 'redwood-1-small', prompt: 'hello' })
console.log(resp.output)
```
I'll drop that into a branch.

sam.devex: Thanks. Also the curl example uses `Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_TOKEN` which will confuse folks. I'll update to `$REDWOOD_API_KEY` and add a one-line note about env var naming. Will push to a branch.

olivia-qa: I tried reproducing the flow on my mac (node 18) — after renaming the env var it passes, but the containerized step `docker run -e REDWOOD_TOKEN` still fails. Should be `-e REDWOOD_API_KEY`. Also suggest adding a smoke test in `docs/ci/quickstart-smoke.sh` to catch this going forward.

jamal-product: Prefer minimal churn — can we keep a migration note: 'Previously REDWOOD_TOKEN; new SDKs use REDWOOD_API_KEY' so existing tutorials don't break abruptly? Also add a compat snippet for v5 users (one-liner).

maria.docs: Good call. I'll add a short 'Compatibility' callout with a v5 snippet. I'll open a PR draft and tag @alex-sdk @sam-devex for review. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3456 (draft).

ci-bot: CI: docs/spellcheck passed; quickstart smoke FAILED (exit 2). See logs: ./ci/quickstart-smoke.sh: line 23: REDWOOD_API_KEY: unbound variable

sam.devex: I'll update `ci/quickstart-smoke.sh` to set a test key and make the check non-fatal if missing. Pushing commit to branch `docs/hello-lite-fix`.

alex-sdk: Added the v6 snippet in the PR and left a small comment about `new Redwood()` options. LGTM otherwise.

maria.docs: PR merged to main. Thanks everyone :tada: — I also added the compat note and CI smoke test fix. Closing the thread.
